title: Kobitz shown an atomically bonded bulkhead underground at Wright-Patterson
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Kobitz shown an atomically bonded bulkhead underground at Wright-Patterson, about unspecified at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he was taken into a room under heavy guard Mhm. and shown what he described to me as the piece of a bulkhead.
